lines.text: When it's time for the sun to set, I begin to climb the hill.
I don't know why. I just felt like it.
It's a habit, I suppose.
One day, as I was crumpling up an already crumpled piece of paper once more
and staring up at the sky,
I was suddenly enveloped in shadow.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: What was your day like?
That was how I first met her.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: You looked sad, so I decided to talk to you.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: I'm not bothering you, am I?
At the time, I felt like she was.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: I am, aren't I?
I thought if I kept quiet, she'd stop bothering me and leave me alone.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: What are you holding onto?

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: An Ark lottery ticket?

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: I see...
But she didn't respond the way I expected.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Your family is up there, aren't they?
Instead, she placed a flower petal in my hand.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: If you let the wind carry this, it will eventually reach your family.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Wouldn't they prefer a beautiful flower over a scrap piece of paper?
The petal fluttered up and away from my hand and the wind carried it up high.
I stood there blankly for a while, watching it fly away as she sat next to me.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: I'm Rinne.

lines.speaker: linne
lines.text: What's your name?
For reasons I can't quite explain, even though I had never spoken since coming down the Ark...
On that day, my lips parted for the first time.

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: ... Trina.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: ... Trina.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Uh... Trina?

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: ... Yes?

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Are you ready?

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: Oh. Just a moment.

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: It's just...

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: seeing these flowers brought me back for a moment.

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: Is everyone ready?
*Chirp chirp*

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: Right, right.

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: We're ready, Flora.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Are you all ready, too?

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Haha, okay.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Lilac and Margaret are joining us, and they're ready as well.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Now, then.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Shall we begin the tea party?

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: Sounds good!

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: ... I'm sorry,

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: but I have a question.

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: For us?

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Well...
*Clatter*
Flora places a teacup in front of Mana.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Lilac worries that

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: it might be rude to keep a guest waiting

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: without serving them some refreshments.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Margaret thinks so as well.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: So, before we hear Aster's question,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: why don't we serve the drinks first?

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Would warm water be sufficient for you, Aster?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Uh... sure.
*Pour*

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: And you, Trina?

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: Could I please have warm water as well?

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: As for the little ones...
*Chirp chirp*

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: They would prefer some cold water, please and thank you.
*Pour*

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: There we are.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Now that we're properly prepared, we can commence our tea party.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: So, what was your question, Aster?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: It's...

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: What am I doing at your tea party?

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: Oh dear, what a question!

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: We're not making you uncomfortable, are we?

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: That... That makes me kinda sad...
... *Chirp*

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: It's not that, but...

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: Wonderful! So there isn't any problem.
*Chirp!*

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: I came here on business.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: I had no intention of being involved in a tea party...

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Aster.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: The Botanic Garden Squad holds regular tea parties.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: During these gatherings, we discuss all manner of matters

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: with the plants growing in our greenhouse.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: However, as you know, Trina and I rarely leave the garden,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: so we often don't have much to share with the little ones.

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: Very true...

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: Usually, it's not a big deal, since we have Leaf with us,

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: but she's up on the surface right now bringing in new little ones.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: So please, if it's not too much trouble,

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: could you tell the children about what is going on in the outside world?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: That's kind of a big question to answer...

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Lilac and Margaret are curious as well.

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: My little ones also want to know.
*Chirp!*

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: I'm honestly pretty similar to you guys. I spend all my time in the research lab.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: I don't have many stories to tell.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Today's the first time I've made it out of the lab in a week.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: Oh...
*Chirp*...

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: *Sigh*...

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: Well then... how about we listen to the radio?
The only government approved anti-aging injection in the Ark.
Evergreen.
Enjoy your youth for longer.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: They just keep playing this same ad over and over.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: If I'm not mistaken, the Sovereigns were the only ones who could receive Evergreen.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: After the First Invasion, the Ark's production system wasn't yet fully established.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Before the prices eventually stabilized, it was seen as a luxury item only the Sovereigns could afford.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Now, however, everyone has easy access to it, which is a good thing.

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: Yes, it's a relief.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: And we're back.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Right now, you're listening to Classic DIVA, hosted by me, Noise.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: In part 2, we will be reading stories from our listeners and playing your song requests.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Since the Spring Festa is right around the corner,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: we've gathered some romantic stories related to spring guaranteed to make your hearts flutter.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: We'll be accepting story submissions all the way through the festival,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: so if you've got one, be sure to send it into the program.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Before we read the stories, I'll give a brief introduction to the Spring Festa.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: This year's festival is jam-packed with all sorts of special events.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Since we've got Missilis's very own Botanic Garden Squad on deck as hosts,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: not only will the cherry blossoms from the surface be open to the public, but the Ark's gardens will also be available for viewing,

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: so you all can look forward to th...
Flora turns off the radio.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: ... Yes, I know, Lilac. This is my first time hearing about this too.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: What's that, Margaret?

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: How could they make this kind of decision without telling us?

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Unfortunately, this world is filled with people who don't consider the thoughts and feelings of others.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Hmm? You'd like to know who?

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Allow me to apologize on their behalf.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: I was going to mention it earlier,

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: but I originally came here to convey orders from Syuen.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Lobelia issued orders for us?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: In the interest of upholding market shares, Missilis has secured the rights to run this year's Spring Festa.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Botanic Garden is to spare no expense in ensuring the festival's success,

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: including opening the gardens.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: If Lobelia is the one that arranged this deal, then why is the responsibility being thrust on us?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Because it's a festival focused on flowers,

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: which makes you perfect for it...

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: *Sigh*...

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: It's not like we'd be able to refuse, anyway.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Okay then, so for the festi...

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: No. We refuse.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Trina?

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: We mustn't open up the garden.

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: We can't.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: You do realize the consequences of disobeying Syuen's orders, don't you?

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: It doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: This is what we can do.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: The domain which we oversee

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: is divided into three sections:

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: My garden, which is filled with flowers.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Trina's arboretum, filled with trees.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: And Leaf's specimen lab, filled with seeds.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: For the festival, we'll open up my section, and my section only.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Will that be acceptable?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: I'll report back to Syuen and let you know.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: How about you, Trina? Are you okay with that?

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: ... Yes. Thank you, Flora.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: flora
lines.text: Now then, Aster, is your work done here?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Yes,

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: but there is something personal

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: I would like to speak with you about.

lines.speaker: trina
lines.text: With me?

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Rinne's research lab will be cleared out soon, before the end of the festival.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: If you left anything important there, you should retrieve it before then.

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Unless you left everything there intentionally.
